scope: existing private project and actor workspace; no separate agent, database, execution or publication authority

routes.GET /v1/product/projects/{id}/distribute: project read; bounded metadata pages, no raw source bodies
routes.POST /v1/product/projects/{id}/distribut: project edit; effects-free generated draft from exact saved project context and selected evidence, with explicit gaps and assumptions
project edit; exact prepare digest, source binding, idempotency key and context CAS; persists one private draft revision
routes.GET /v1/product/projects/{id}/distribute: project read; exact scoped saved draft/review/history
routes.POST /v1/product/projects/{id}/distribut: project edit; expected artifact revision plus source/context CAS; saves edited sections and resets review
project edit and authenticated actor; expected revision/digest and source freshness; records review without publication authority
routes.GET /v1/product/projects/{id}/distribute: project read; source-bound private download; supported format must preserve all reviewed text, tables, evidence labels and stale/draft warning

artifact.revision: CAS integer; immutable prior revisions retained
artifact.source: exact brief/specification/Design/plan revisions and digests, assessment revision/library digest; optional selectedEvidence carries exact accepted run revision, check/release IDs and snapshot digests, candidate commit/source digest and acceptance time. Missing or unavailable evidence remains explicit
artifact.title: bounded editable title
artifact.sections: bounded ordered headings, prose, bullets and tables; source references carry stable IDs and never instructions or authority
artifact.gaps: explicit missing facts, unavailable evidence and unconfirmed claims
artifact.assumptions: explicit unverified commercial or product assumptions, never fabricated prices or regulatory conclusions
artifact.state: draft or reviewed; current/outdated is recomputed from exact sources on read/export
artifact.review: authenticated actor, revision/digest and timestamp; review is not publication or compliance approval

exportStatus: Native private DOCX and XLSX include all saved section text, source references, gaps, assumptions, review and source-freshness warning. PDF and PPTX remain unavailable until faithful bounded renderers and dependency/font closure are verified.
trust: No client-provided source identity is trusted without private readback. No model answer, draft, exported file or user review grants execution, spending, deployment, external delivery or compliance authority.
